briefing.headline: xAI Colossus cluster hits 1M H100s as OpenAI o4 edges toward AGI thresholds

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models amid record compute deployments. Regulatory scrutiny grows over agentic systems while security vulnerabilities persist across production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; xAI deploys Grok-3 on expanded Colossus; DeepSeek-V3 and Meta Llama 4 trail closely in benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins targeting high-risk agents.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Microsoft and Google announce joint 500MW data center expansions; TSMC ramps 2nm AI chips; Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI infrastructure.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI emerge from a coalition of Western labs or a single state-backed Chinese entity by 2028?
